cardEditor.title: Card Editor
cardEditor.dialog.title: Bulk Card Editor
cardEditor.dialog.draft.restored: Restored your unsent settings and notes from last time.
cardEditor.dialog.presets.title: Presets
cardEditor.dialog.presets.name: Preset name
cardEditor.dialog.presets.namePlaceholde: Type a new name or pick a saved preset
cardEditor.dialog.presets.hint: Presets save every setting below except the targets and their notes.
cardEditor.dialog.targets.title: Targets · {{count}} characters
cardEditor.dialog.targets.empty: No targets left — close and select at least one character.
cardEditor.dialog.targets.unloadableBloc: Remove cards that could not be loaded before dispatching.
cardEditor.dialog.model.title: Model
cardEditor.dialog.model.customTemplateHi: The full prompt template sent for every card. Choosing Custom prefills this field with the current preset's body.
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.title: Instructions & references
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.globalPla: Applies to every card — e.g. tighten prose, remove meta commentary…
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.behaviorH: One card whose behavior, judgment, and writing style guide how edits are written. The directive and notes still decide what changes.
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.lorebooks: Reference context applied to every card.
cardEditor.dialog.processing.title: Processing
cardEditor.dialog.processing.modeBatched: Batched — XML, N cards per call
cardEditor.dialog.processing.rebalanceHi: Splits content into Description / Personality / Backstory / Appearance / Scenario.
cardEditor.dialog.processing.completionC: Apply mode holds stale cards for review instead of overwriting them. Duplicates use this session's prefix or suffix.
cardEditor.dialog.processing.autoDisable: The Card Editor's bulk settings require review, so auto-approve and on-completion writes are disabled here.
cardEditor.dialog.processing.overflowCap: On context overflow the failed batch is split and re-dispatched automatically until single-card calls remain.
cardEditor.dialog.saving.title: Saving
cardEditor.dialog.saving.auto: In-place — auto-approve (saves each character's latest revision)
cardEditor.dialog.saving.duplicatePrefix: Both affixes apply: copies are named prefix + name + suffix. Blank boxes are ignored.
cardEditor.dialog.saving.duplicateRemove: Strip this from the start of the copy name
Strip this from the end of the copy name
cardEditor.dialog.saving.combinedCaption: Each character's generated XML document is joined into ONE new card's description — no per-card writes.
cardEditor.dialog.saving.combinedNameReq: Enter a name for the combined card before dispatching.
cardEditor.dialog.saving.reviewRequiredH: The bulk settings require review, so auto-approve is unavailable — dispatches wait for your confirmation.
cardEditor.dialog.saving.caption: In-place always writes a new revision. Auto-approve holds back cards that genuinely changed mid-run for review. Duplicates are renamed by the affixes above — prefix, suffix, and removals combine. Combined concatenates each generated XML document into one new card.
cardEditor.panel.title: Bulk runs
cardEditor.panel.deleteConfirm: Delete this session? Its results are lost.
cardEditor.panel.deleteConfirmActive: Still running — cancel it and delete?
cardEditor.panel.interruptedNotice: The server restarted mid-run, so this session was interrupted. Failed items can still be retried from this session.
cardEditor.panel.detail.loadError: The session could not be loaded.
cardEditor.panel.detail.combinePartialCo: {{count}} of {{total}} cards were collected. Create the combined card from the collected cards only?
cardEditor.panel.detail.duplicateApplied: {{failed}} of {{total}} cards could not be duplicated — retry from the item row.
cardEditor.panel.settings.title: Bulk settings
cardEditor.panel.settings.maxParallelAge: Upper bound on concurrent calls in bulk runs. 0 follows the connection's parallel job limit.
cardEditor.panel.settings.disableAutoVer: Bulk dispatches always wait for your confirmation; auto-approve and on-completion apply/duplicate are turned off.
cardEditor.queue.title: Review changes
cardEditor.queue.duplicateNote: Approving copies the current card and applies these fields to the copy.
cardEditor.queue.staleTitle: {{count}} fields changed since the run — applying replaces them.
cardEditor.queue.applyFailed: Applying failed: {{message}} — rerun the item from the session table.
cardEditor.queue.reportFailed: The card was written but the confirmation could not be sent: {{message}} — reload the session to see the true state.
cardEditor.editRetry.title: Edit & retry — {{name}}
cardEditor.editRetry.hint: The exact rendered prompt sent to the model. Retry re-dispatches this card with the edited text.
cardEditor.editRetry.missing: The rendered prompt was not retained for this item; use rerun instead.
cardEditor.fixJson.title: Fix JSON — {{name}}
cardEditor.fixJson.hint: The model's response could not be parsed, even after auto-repair and a strict-JSON retry. Fix it and apply, or retry generation.
cardEditor.workspace.title: Card Editor
cardEditor.transform.title: Schema transform
cardEditor.transform.schemasError: Schemas could not be loaded. Close the dialog and try again.
cardEditor.transform.multiTitle: When one card describes several characters
cardEditor.transform.multiMergeHint: One result per source card. Each character gets its own document on that card.
cardEditor.transform.multiSplitHint: You confirm every split first. Split characters become new cards linked to the source, and the source card is never changed.
cardEditor.transform.outputStructuredHin: The model fills the schema as data and Marinara writes it as {{format}}.
cardEditor.transform.outputDocument: The model writes the document itself
cardEditor.transform.outputDocumentHint: The earlier method: the model writes each field's document text directly. Validation is skipped.
cardEditor.transform.providerJsonOn: Provider JSON mode is on for the Card Editor agent. Connections that support it enforce the response shape; others use the normal prompt.
cardEditor.transform.providerJsonOff: Provider JSON mode is off. Turn on “Use structured output” in the Card Editor agent settings to let supported connections enforce the response shape.
cardEditor.transform.providerJsonUnknown: This Engine version does not report provider JSON mode, so the normal prompt is used.
cardEditor.transform.phase2Hint: After every split is decided, every Phase 1 result is processed again. Nothing is written to your cards until Phase 2 finishes.
cardEditor.transform.phase2InstructionPl: For example: tighten the prose and make each card name its relations to the others.
cardEditor.pipeline.label: Run totals
cardEditor.pipeline.splitsAccepted: {{count}} source card(s) split into several characters
cardEditor.panel.detail.splitProposed: The model proposes {{count}} characters for this card.
cardEditor.panel.detail.splitInto: Split into {{count}} new cards. This card stays unchanged.
cardEditor.split.title: Split review · {{name}}
cardEditor.split.sourceEmpty: The source card has no description.
cardEditor.split.outcome: Accepting creates {{count}} new cards linked to the source. The source card is not changed.
cardEditor.schemas.title: Schema studio
cardEditor.schemas.nodeAttributesHint: One per line as name=a | b | c. Leave the values empty for freeform; end with etc. to allow other values.
cardEditor.schemas.previewHint.markdown: The template the model sees when it writes Markdown itself.
cardEditor.schemas.previewHint.xml: The template the model sees when it writes XML itself.
cardEditor.schemas.previewHint.json: The data shape the model fills in structured mode, for every output format.
cardEditor.schemas.previewHint.schema: Sent as provider structured output when the connection supports it.
cardEditor.schemas.name: Schema name
cardEditor.schemas.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Runs that already used it keep their copy.
cardEditor.avatar.title: Avatar studio
cardEditor.avatar.sourcesHint: Defaults to every card in this run. The source images are never changed.
cardEditor.avatar.canvasLabel: Avatar composite. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom. With the canvas focused: Tab changes cell, arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, 0 resets the cell.
cardEditor.avatar.keys: Tab changes cell · arrows pan · + and − zoom · 0 resets
